patch_list: Lets any Android Auto compatible host connect to Home Assistant's car screens, including DriveDeck, Gearslip, MyCar, Flywheel, BetterAuto, AndroidAuto and AARE, whatever its package name or signing key. Google's Android Auto keeps working.

Lets any Android Auto compatible host connect to Home Assistant's car screens, including DriveDeck, Gearslip, MyCar, Flywheel, BetterAuto, AndroidAuto and AARE, whatever its package name or signing key. Google's Android Auto keeps working.

Ports the Automotive build to Android Auto and compatible templated hosts. Keeps Home Assistant's native car screens, phone sign-in and real host-provided car data, and retains Automotive behavior on devices that provide it.
